title: A Special Room for the Prophet
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler with the warm, welcoming heart, and tonight a kind woman builds a little room for the prophet: Willow gets her own room ready for Grandma, with a cleared chair, a cup of water, her softest blanket and a flower by the lamp.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because her warm heart is always making room for someone. In Willow’s world today: Grandma is coming to stay for the weekend. Willow clears the toys off the little chair in her room. She sets a cup of water on the table and lays her softest blanket on the bed. Then she puts a flower beside the lamp. Just like the kind woman who built a little room for Elisha, Willow learned that making room says you are welcome here.
